$comment: Part II Section A — the economic operator (EO) identity. Hand-authored (administrative, not a criterion). Field set is the Schematron-mandated minimum for the RESPONSE (BR-RESP-10-02..07, all error-level): role, identifier, name, size, country. The EA I71 'info-eo' block also carries optional address/contact/website and a QualifyingParty — deferred (see partII/README.md). NB: Part II Section A ALSO contains four OT* criteria (SME size question, reserved participation, official-list registration, group participation) which are compiler territory, NOT modelled here.
title: ESPD Part II Section A — Economic Operator

economicOperator.description: Identity of the economic operator. Maps to cac:EconomicOperatorParty. The role lives on cac:EconomicOperatorRole; the rest on the nested cac:Party.

role.description: The EO's function in this bid (sole tenderer, group leader/member, other-entity-relied-on, subcontractor). Mandatory (BR-RESP-10-02/03, error). Maps to cac:EconomicOperatorRole/cbc:RoleCode (eo-role-type).

name.description: Official name of the economic operator. Mandatory (BR-RESP-10-05, error). Maps to cac:Party/cac:PartyName/cbc:Name.

size.description: Size of the economic operator. Mandatory (BR-RESP-10-06, error). Maps to cac:Party/cbc:IndustryClassificationCode (economic-operator-size).

country.description: Country of the economic operator, as a Country code. Mandatory (BR-RESP-10-07, error). Maps to cac:Party/cac:PostalAddress/cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode.

lot.description: The single procurement lot this response applies to (a LOT-000n id declared by the buyer in Part I). Mandatory (BR-LOT-10, fatal: a Response specifies EXACTLY ONE lot). Maps to the Response's one cac:ProcurementProjectLot/cbc:ID; the document composer emits exactly this lot.

eoIdentifier.description: An identifier that identifies the economic operator. Mandatory (BR-RESP-10-04, error). Maps to cac:Party/cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID with a mandatory @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02, fatal). The Response sample carries no @schemeID/EOIDType here and there is no scheme to derive an agency from, so @schemeAgencyID is supplied as a constant 'OP' at export, not stored here.

value.description: The identifier value (e.g. 'AD123456789'). Maps to the text of cbc:ID.
